key.name: active-source
key.description: Identifier of the currently selected wallpaper source.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last user-chosen window width; restored on the next launch.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last user-chosen window height; restored on the next launch.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Restore the window maximized when it was maximized at exit.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Zero disables automatic refresh.

key.name: match-theme
key.description: Pick wallpapers that suit the current light or dark appearance.

key.name: match-strictness
key.description: "prefer" falls back to any wallpaper, "require" keeps the current one when nothing matches.

key.name: brightness-threshold
key.description: Wallpapers with an average brightness below this are considered dark.

key.name: refresh-on-theme-change
key.description: Switch the wallpaper immediately when the light/dark preference changes.

key.name: refresh-on-startup
key.description: Download a fresh wallpaper when the app or daemon starts. Off by default.

key.name: manual-paths
key.description: Newline-separated absolute paths picked by the user (files or expanded directory contents).

key.name: start-at-login
key.description: Launch the headless refresh daemon automatically at login via the desktop autostart mechanism.

key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Keep refreshing wallpapers while the window is closed.

key.name: apply-lockscreen
key.description: Apply wallpapers to the lock screen as well.

key.name: screen-geometry
key.description: Size of the largest connected monitor, probed automatically. Never set this manually.

key.name: wallhaven-query
key.description: Search tags; prefix with + to require or - to exclude.

key.name: wallhaven-categories
key.description: General/anime/people switches, in order.

key.name: wallhaven-purity
key.description: SFW/sketchy/NSFW switches, in order. NSFW needs an API key.

key.name: wallhaven-sorting
key.description: Sorting method for search results.

key.name: unsplash-query
key.description: Search terms for Unsplash.

key.name: unsplash-content-filter
key.description: low or high content safety level.

key.name: pexels-query
key.description: Search terms for Pexels.

key.name: pixabay-query
key.description: Search terms for Pixabay.

key.name: pixabay-category
key.description: Optional Pixabay category filter, e.g. nature or backgrounds.
